question: How is the worship of the main circle to be performed?
premises: The worship of the main circle is performed by the inner sequence alone.
The abundance of bliss of consciousness is indeed the inner reality.
Thus inner worship corresponds to the bliss of consciousness.
inference: True worship of the main circle is an inward process grounded in the abundant bliss of consciousness.
plain_english: The worship of the main circle is performed by the inner sequence alone. For the abundance of bliss in consciousness is indeed what is inner.
